0022600085.text: Both the Atlanta Hawks and Orlando Magic open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Hawks on the road in Orlando. Atlanta won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 130-101 win in Orlando on April 1, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Hawks a 45% chance to win. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and Mouhamed Gueye is day-to-day with a foot fracture and a game-time decision, while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery) and has Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Jonathan Isaac (knee sprain) and Noah Penda (hamstring) listed as day-to-day, all game-time decisions.
